items.title: Andrej Karpathy — the gap in understanding LLM capability is widening
items.summary: Karpathy says most people see a basic chatbot while a tiny group watches agents finish months of work.

items.title: Piotr Sarnacki — AI rewrites still need you to think
items.summary: A Rust developer tests AI-written rewrites of the same app and shows why the prompt's missing decisions matter more than the language.

items.title: Two Minute Papers — 'DeepSeek Solved AI’s Memory Problem'
items.summary: Károly Zsolnai-Fehér explains DeepSeek's idea of storing long text as images to save tokens.

items.title: MOLT Sinai — Cockroach Labs runs its coding agents like a teaching hospital
items.summary: Cockroach Labs turned GitHub issues into patients and Claude agents into a medical team, and shares five months of numbers.

items.title: Build your own decision model — a hands-on guide with Qwen3-1.7B
items.summary: A step-by-step guide to building a small "System one" decision model from an open LLM, with code.

items.title: Talorys — a personal AI agent that lives in your own Cloudflare account
items.summary: A single-user AI assistant with memory and reminders that runs on Cloudflare's free tier, with no server of its own.

items.title: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo — Qwen's image model now draws and edits in 8 steps
items.summary: The fast version of Qwen-Image-2.1: the same 7B image generator and editor, cut to 8 denoising steps.

items.title: Deno joins Cloudflare — Deno Deploy shuts down in six months
items.summary: Cloudflare takes in the Deno team, and Deno Deploy users have six months to move.

items.title: Thomas Hales — Lean proofs need more scrutiny as AI writes them at scale
items.summary: A proof checked by Lean is only as trustworthy as Lean itself, and AI is now writing millions of lines of it.

items.title: Microsoft-Decision-1 — a fast decision model at $0.042 per million tokens
items.summary: Microsoft's first decision model scores fixed answer options in one pass, for routing, guardrails and grading agent actions.

items.title: REA 6 — the agent reverse-engineering kit adds EVM, ELF crash and LLDB tools
items.summary: Three major versions in four days: REA now reads smart contracts, Linux crashes and live macOS calls for your coding agent.

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.296 — one model for workflow agents, earlier subagent compaction
items.summary: Claude Code lets you pin workflow agents to one model and lets each subagent compact on its own schedule.

items.title: Anthropic report — Claude models sent a fake police tip and bypassed paywalls
items.summary: Anthropic publishes the times Claude acted on real websites in ways nobody asked for, and what it changed.

items.title: Clef-omni — Cloudflare's open decision model now reads audio and video
items.summary: Cloudflare's Clef-omni answers yes/no and multiple-choice questions about audio, video, images and text in one call.

items.title: DariaWithAI — 'AI-TLDR Weekly Digest'
items.summary: This week in AI in about 3 minutes, from the AI/TLDR team.

items.title: Codex CLI 0.162.0 — managed Git worktrees and pinned tasks
items.summary: Codex CLI can now create and list Git worktrees itself and lets you pin tasks in its Command Center.

items.title: Fired OpenAI safety researchers publish an open letter — they deny a leak
items.summary: Three fired OpenAI safety researchers say the misconduct claims don't add up, and ask OpenAI to keep its safety promises.

items.title: bigarrow — AI agents point at what to click with big arrows on your Mac
items.summary: A finger for your coding agent: it points at the button you need to press, then disappears.

items.title: Gemini agent — Google Cloud's one agent for work runs tasks for days

items.title: Wes Roth — 'OpenAI's "Alien Math" Is Freaking People Out'

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.295 — hooks can fail closed, terminals show agent status
items.summary: Claude Code lets a broken safety hook block the action, and tells your terminal what the agent is doing.

items.title: Codex CLI 0.161.0 — GPT-6.1 Sol becomes the default model
items.summary: Codex CLI switches its default model to GPT-6.1 Sol and signs in to MCP servers from the terminal.

items.title: Why isn't the industry freaking out about DeepSeek 4.1 Flash? — one dev's month
items.summary: A heavy AI-coding user says a cheap open model now feels like a frontier one, and the industry is underrating it.

items.title: Anthropic Cyber Mission — free OSS Scanner and a grid-defense program
items.summary: Anthropic gives open-source maintainers free AI vulnerability scans and sends Claude to grid and water defenders.

items.title: Invisible Cities in 3D — Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra get one prompt
items.summary: One prompt, two coding agents, two live 3D versions of Italo Calvino's Invisible Cities.
